title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle - vendor rke2 + ubuntu-22.04 apt-mirror updates and rollback tooling
author: Sofia Patel
ci_checks: e2e-onprem: passed (flaky on first run, rerun successful)
description: Motivation: air-gapped on-prem installs for Ubuntu 22.04 encountered intermittent apt package resolution failures when using the existing offline bundle layout. This PR updates the offline bundle vendor artifacts for rke2 and adds an optional local apt-mirror helper plus rollback tooling for TUF/metadata. Changes: 1) Vendor: refresh rke2 assets to v1.27.3-rke2 and update checksums for containerd/cri plugins; 2) Offline bundles: reorganize ubuntu-22.04 bundle layout to include apt index snapshots and pre-seeded APT pool to improve apt-get reliability in strict air-gapped installs; 3) Apt mirror helper: scripts/apt-mirror/setup.sh - a minimal tool and systemd unit to expose a local apt mirror from the bundle and populate package indexes at first-boot; 4) Rollback tooling: tools/rollback/rollback_tool.go + docs to allow rollback of TUF snapshot metadata and reindex an offline bundle when a corrupted mirror is detected; 5) Helm chart: small templating changes to mount apt-mirror configmap for on-prem installer; 6) Docs: onprem/airgap/ubuntu-22.04.md with upgrade/rollback steps and verification checklist. Testing: validated full airgap install on rke2 (1.27.3) using a 3-node lab cluster (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS) and ran the platform e2e smoke suite. The first e2e run surfaced a timing issue where apt indexes were not fully populated; CI rerun succeeded after adding a short wait/retry in the setup script. Checklist: - [x] vendor rke2 assets refreshed and checksums recorded - [x] apt-mirror helper implemented and unit tested - [x] rollback tool implemented and tested in lab - [x] documentation updated - [x] CI e2e passing Notes: This PR is intended to be safe for existing bundles; apt-mirror helper is opt-in via a chart value. Rolling forward will be done via the usual release process. Related: ENG-2345 (airgap stability), SUP-912 (customer incident).
